scene nightsky
I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer. And no, I will not be allowing her to drag me to karaoke again if that is what she wants to do.
I more or less just want to see how she’s doing in the greater context of being a seemingly half-possessed human who I have now had a gratuitous amount of weird sex with.
Oh wow. I wonder if this is how everyone feels when they dial my number?
I’ll have to ask Nodoka or something. She’s no stranger to railing all of the mental fallacies out of me.
: Goodbye!
: Hey, Kaori. How are you?
: My temperature is regular and all of my body parts are in the correct place! It’s an excellent day!
: Are you working right now? Or are you at home?
: I am currently teaching Nao-chan how to write exciting stories about large bugs who try to blend in with regular humans!
: That is an oddly specific thing to teach someone about that I’m sure will prove to be invaluable at some point in her life.
: There is a problem though, Friend. I do not know how to write stories about things like this or I would have done it myself.
: Help! You know how to make bad words into good words, yes? What is a better word for “bug?”
: ...Insect?
: The story is now complete! Nao-chan will soon be the next King Stephen!
: And what is he the king of exactly?
: Nightmares.
: A surprisingly tame answer.
: Hello!
: Wait — if you’re done teaching Nao, do you want to hang out? I could come over to your place or something?
: Please do! I have been eagerly awaiting your next visit now that I know how it feels to mate, but I felt strange about asking you to come do that to me!
: Even now, my face grows hot just thinking about it!
: That’s not really why I’m-
: The excitement grows! I will look at you soon! Hi!
Kaori hangs up before I have the chance to tell her I’m not just using her as a booty call and that I genuinely do just want to check in on her.
But hey, if sex is on the table, I imagine that soon she will be too.
scene black
I slide my phone back into my pocket and begin to make my way over to Kaori’s place.
So this time, if I’m teleported into another realm with her adopted daughter, at least our main bodies will remain in a safe location for her to supervise and potentially defile.
Those things are essentially interchangeable for me, so I’d say that works out perfectly.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis1
: Friend! Welcome back to my separatement! It has been many minutes, hasn’t it? Do you remember the rules?
: The rules of...being in your apartment?
: Correct! Do not feed the chicken or the Nao-chan or the Frog Boy or anything else. And please remember that the bath tub can only fit one person.
: Do people normally come over here to use your bath?
: Not yet! But I assume it will happen eventually, so I want to make sure I’m prepared and not surprised by any spontaneous bath gatherings.
: Great. Well, thank you for reminding me of the house rules. And hello, Nao.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis2
: Nao-chan! Now that your lessons are complete, you may do or play anything you like! Even if it’s that game where there is a sphere that you catch in a basket on a stick!
: ...Lacrosse?
scene kaoriaptwantspenis3
: The cross, yes! And we will play a different game! Using our human bodies as the sphere and the stick! Forever!
: Forever?
scene kaoriaptwantspenis4
: Yes.
: I’m sorry, but I don’t think I’m physically capable of that yet. Thanks for giving me one more reason to keep practicing, though.
: Yeah, you just stay out of this. Go play lacrosse.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis5
: What happens now? Where do I go? What do I do? I do not remember how things started last time. I think my mind was erased from all the mating.
: Step one — get on the bed.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis6
: I have arrived at the designated mating spot! You may begin!
: Not yet. There’s a step two first.
: Would it not be “step two second?”
: That...maybe. I don’t know. Either way, step two — you need to learn when the right and wrong time to do this is or you’ll wind up getting one of us in trouble.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis7
: Did a mistake occur? I thought sex-mating was acceptable in one’s home. This is why I did not ask to sex-mate in the singing room or at the lemon assistance stand despite how much I wanted to.
: You kind of asked at the lemonade stand. You’re really thinking about this that much, though?
: Should I not do that?
: I mean...you can. It’s just kind of weird to see you having urges like this all of a sudden when you’ve been pretty much sexually dormant for as long as I’ve known you.
: What is that? “Sexually dormant?”
: Like...every time you’ve mentioned “mating” in the past, it’s seemed more scientific than anything.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis8
: Not true! You have always flustered me and made my legs shake, Sexfriend! I just never understood how good things could feel until I became a cat!
: Which is fine. But we’re still not alone right now. Nao is literally right there.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis9
: Oh. Perhaps she does not like the cross?
: Can we not mate while she is present? We have done it before. In fact, she has been present for 100%% of the times that we have done it. Even the kiss move.
: But she shouldn’t be because sex is a private thing between two people. Except for when it’s not.
: Then I declare that it is not! Please begin!
: Sure. As soon as she leaves the room.
: Nao-chan! Leave the room so your mothermom can engage in the sex with Friend! Your turn will come later!
scene kaoriaptwantspenis10
: No. She doesn’t get a turn. Only you do.
: That seems very rude to Nao-chan. It is only fair that she gets to experience the same joy that we do, correct?
: Incorrect. She needs to wait a few years until she...develops more. And this is something you need to accept as her caretaker or you will cause irreparable harm to both her body and mind.
: Oh, stop pretending to be such a good guy.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis11
: We both know you’d pound that little girl six ways from Sunday. And you’re being handed the opportunity to do just that on a silver platter.
: What do you gain from saying “no” other than one more chance to fool yourself into believing there’s some sort of conscience left in that little head of yours, Aki-kun?
: Can you please just...get out of there and stop playing with her head? It’s unfair that one voice leaves just for you to start taking over more.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis12
: And always when her heart starts racing too. Cool, right?
: Sekai-
: Kaori. My name is Kaori. And even when I’m not the me inside of me, the fundamentals of my beliefs are still the same, Aki-kun.
: I don’t know it’s wrong for you to fuck little Nao-chan over there. So I won’t have a problem with it. Now, go on! Get those feet wet. And by “feet” I obviously mean something else.
: Or just screw me like this in front of her. I don’t wanna change back, though. I forgot how good sex feels as someone without any experience.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis13
: It was a mistake coming here at all, wasn’t it?
: A mistake? Or something you secretly hoped would happen since you know I like to hang out in here now?
: Let’s mate, Aki-kun! Then wash it all down with a little taste of that forbidden fruit over there. Sounds fun, right?
scene kaoriaptwantspenis14
: Nao, stop drawing and just leave already. You can see what’s happening over here, can’t you?
scene kaoriaptwantspenis15
: Of course she can, but she doesn’t care! She’s not a real girl, so why would she?
: Just think of her like one of those super impure fantasies that are always swimming around in your head, Aki-kun. It’s just like masturbation when you think of it like that, isn’t it?
: In fact, didn’t you use that same sort of mindset to justify fucking everyone when you first woke up here? Why the change of heart now? Do I need to possess you next?
: I don’t even want to think about that — but the change of heart was due to me learning. And accepting people as more than just figments of my imagination.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis16
: Yet, you don’t accept this girl as that.
: Which means that argument falls flat and is now propped up by little more than some weird sense of morality and righteous obligation that I definitely didn’t teach you.
: Just let go! Have fun! How do you expect to ever fuck the rich girl and her poor friend if you can’t even put it inside of the mute orphan girl? She’s the easiest target possible.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis17
: Isn’t that right, Nao-chan?
scene kaoriaptwantspenis18
: Ah.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis19
: She’s just feeling a little shy right now.
: Yeah. Sure she is, Kaori.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis20
: I mean it! Just because she hasn’t come around to me yet doesn’t mean she won’t come around to you!
: I swear, though — if you come over here and start pulling this thing’s clothes off, she’ll be purring before you even know it. Won’t you, Nao-chan?
scene kaoriaptwantspenis21
: ...Helloooooo? Anyone home?
: Just leave her alone...she doesn’t need to be pulled into the same pit that we come from.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis22
: Neither did Kaori and she seems to be thriving there, doesn’t she? We were happy too until I was roadkill. So maybe that “pit” isn’t as bad as you think, Aki-kun?
: What’s the name of that one girl who can’t seem to move the fuck on again? Mei? Meiko? M...Mayonnaise?
: You know. The one who looks like she crawled out of a gutter. Wears a bell? Kind of a slut? The gross one who shares a dorm with my perfect little girl.
: Can’t say I’m a fan of this new seduction tactic. Having the people I care about trash-talked isn’t one of my biggest turn ons.
: Yeah, but a little girl who won’t say no is and that’s not working either. So I don’t know what I’m supposed to do anymore!
scene kaoriaptwantspenis23
: Would it kill you to just leave me alone?
: I don’t know. Does it have four wheels and top out at 160kmph?
: Hah...
: This was a mistake. I really shouldn’t come here anymore.
: What? Why?
scene kaoriaptwantspenis24
: Because you-
scene kaoriaptwantspenis25
: Did another mistake happen?
: Kaori-
: The other me came out, yes?
: Is she a bad girl? Because she is gone now. And it will be the me on the outside of me that you will do the sex things with.
: Please?...
: I need you to touch me or more clouds will come. And there are so many of them now that I am having a hard time thinking straight, Friend.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis26
: I think...I am in heat again...
: And the only way I can feel better is for you to touch me and clear my skies once more...
: I understand that asking for your sexual participation outright is an undesirable trait in a prospective female companion, but I don’t know what else to do anymore...and...
: And um...
scene kaoriaptwantspenis27
: It feels as if...there is a part of me missing...when you are not inside...
scene kaoriaptwantspenis28
: Please...Friend?
: Can you help me feel better?...
scene kaoriaptwantspenis29
I glance over to find the one reason I haven’t yet still sitting there at the table — nose buried in a notebook full of bugs and other things.
And I think to myself, caught in the tailwinds of my savior, that it isn’t inherently harmful for her to just be there.
if tsukasacurious == True:
I’ve done as much with Tsukasa already. And even if I regret it, that didn’t harm her.
So maybe Nao is a good way to...test things. Assuming she wants to.
Or maybe it’s her vulnerability that makes putting her in this spotlight somehow worse, regardless of whether she’s “real” or not.
else:
But will she really just “be” there, I wonder? Or will her curiosity get the best of her?
This has happened once before and she remained on the outside of the world Kaori and I built around one another.
I just worry that having her this close might pull her in, willing or not.
: Nao.
: You know what’s about to happen...This is your chance to leave.
: She doesn’t want to leave yet...She wants to write another story.
: So do I — but instead, I’m about to write the same one all over again.
: Friend...I can not take it much longer...
: The me inside of me is screaming...begging to be one with you. And I feel so...warm. And confused. And...like I...need you...
: I need you...I need you...I need you!
: You know...
scene black
